001package com.streamconverter.command.impl.xml;
002
003import com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand;
004import com.streamconverter.path.ITreeMatcher;
005import com.streamconverter.security.SecureXmlConfiguration;
006import java.io.IOException;
007import java.io.InputStream;
008import java.io.OutputStream;
009import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
010import java.io.Writer;
011import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
012import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventReader;
013import javax.xml.stream.XMLInputFactory;
014import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
015import javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent;
016import org.slf4j.Logger;
017import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
018
019/**
020 * XML Filter Command Class
021 *
022 * <p>This class implements pure data extraction from XML using TreePath expressions. Unlike
023 * XmlWalker which applies transformations, XmlFilterCommand only extracts/filters elements based on
024 * specified paths without any modifications.
025 *
026 * <p>Features: - Extract specific elements using TreePath expressions - Preserve exact XML
027 * structure of extracted elements - Memory-efficient streaming processing - Support for complex
028 * path expressions including nested elements and attributes
029 */
030public class XmlFilterCommand implements IStreamCommand {
031  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(XmlFilterCommand.class);
032
033  private final ITreeMatcher xpath;
034
035  private XmlFilterCommand(ITreeMatcher xpath) {
036    this.xpath = xpath;
037  }
038
039  /**
040   * Factory method for XML filtering with typed path selector.
041   *
042   * @param xpath the typed path to extract elements
043   * @return an XmlFilterCommand instance
044   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if xpath is null
045   */
046  public static XmlFilterCommand create(ITreeMatcher xpath) {
047    if (xpath == null) {
048      throw new IllegalArgumentException("xpath cannot be null");
049    }
050    return new XmlFilterCommand(xpath);
051  }
052
053  @Override
054  public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
055    try (Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
056      XMLEventReader reader = createReader(inputStream);
057      processEvents(reader, writer);
058    }
059  }
060
061  private XMLEventReader createReader(InputStream inputStream) throws IOException {
062    XMLInputFactory inputFactory = SecureXmlConfiguration.createSecureXMLInputFactory();
063    try {
064      return inputFactory.createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
065    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
066      throw new IOException("Error creating XML reader: " + e.getMessage(), e);
067    }
068  }
069
070  private void processEvents(XMLEventReader reader, Writer writer) throws IOException {
071    try {
072      XmlExtractionState state =
073          new XmlExtractionState(SecureXmlConfiguration.createSecureXMLOutputFactory());
074      drainEvents(reader, writer, state);
075      if (state.isCaptureOpen()) {
076        state.abortCapture();
077      }
078      String remaining = state.firstElementConsumed ? null : state.firstExtractedElement;
079      XmlOutputEmitter.writeRemaining(writer, remaining, state.isWrappedOutput);
080    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
081      throw new IOException("Error processing XML: " + e.getMessage(), e);
082    } finally {
083      closeReader(reader);
084    }
085  }
086
087  private void drainEvents(XMLEventReader reader, Writer writer, XmlExtractionState state)
088      throws XMLStreamException, IOException {
089    while (reader.hasNext()) {
090      XMLEvent event = reader.nextEvent();
091      if (event.isStartElement()) {
092        handleStartElement(event, state);
093      } else if (event.isEndElement()) {
094        handleEndElement(event, writer, state);
095      } else if (state.isCapturing()) {
096        addEventToCapture(event, state);
097      }
098    }
099  }
100
101  private void closeReader(XMLEventReader reader) {
102    try {
103      reader.close();
104    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
105      logger.warn("Error closing XML reader: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
106    }
107  }
108
109  private void handleStartElement(XMLEvent event, XmlExtractionState state) throws IOException {
110    state.currentDepth++;
111    state.currentPath.add(event.asStartElement().getName().getLocalPart());
112    if (xpath.matches(state.currentPath) && !state.isCapturing()) {
113      try {
114        state.startCapture(state.currentDepth, event);
115      } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
116        state.resetCapture();
117        throw new IOException("Error writing start element at path: " + state.currentPath, e);
118      }
119    } else if (state.isCapturing() && state.currentDepth > state.captureDepth) {
120      addEventToCapture(event, state);
121    }
122  }
123
124  private void handleEndElement(XMLEvent event, Writer writer, XmlExtractionState state)
125      throws IOException, XMLStreamException {
126    if (state.isCapturing()) {
127      addEventToCapture(event, state);
128      if (state.isCapturing() && state.currentDepth == state.captureDepth) {
129        XmlOutputEmitter.emit(writer, state.finishCapture(), state);
130      }
131    }
132    state.currentPath.remove(state.currentPath.size() - 1);
133    state.currentDepth--;
134  }
135
136  private void addEventToCapture(XMLEvent event, XmlExtractionState state) throws IOException {
137    try {
138      state.addToCapture(event);
139    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
140      state.resetCapture();
141      throw new IOException("Error writing XML content", e);
142    }
143  }
144}
